prompt: You expose tools from several services and must pick a naming scheme: prefix-based (`asana_search`) or suffix-based (`search_asana`). How does Anthropic suggest deciding?

options.text: Always use suffixes, because verbs should come first.
Always use prefixes, because they are universally better.
Avoid namespacing entirely, since it confuses models.
Test both on your own tool-use evaluations, because the effect is non-trivial and varies by LLM.

explanation: Namespacing groups related tools under common prefixes to clarify boundaries. Anthropic found prefix versus suffix choices have non-trivial effects on tool-use evaluations that vary by model, and recommends choosing by your own evals.
